info: Static-optimisation surrogate. Inputs: kinematics. Outputs: 289 targets -- 80 muscle forces, 18 JRF components, 6 JRF magnitude, 6 GRF, 13 joint moments, 80 activations, 80 muscle power, 6 hip JCF in pelvis.
provenance: FAIS cohort, 18 training subjects, held out 015,024,025,033. Trained from OpenSim StaticOptimization + JointReaction (rajagopal_fai; source kinematics_only_model.pkl).
units_detail: forces (muscle, JRF, GRF, hip-in-pelvis) in bodyweight = N / (mass_kg * 9.80665); joint moments in N.m/kg; activations 0-1; muscle power in W/kg
frames: JRF in the child body frame (femur/tibia/talus); hip_*_pelvis_* in the pelvis frame (x anterior, y up, z right), sign = force of pelvis on femur; GRF in the OpenSim ground frame
